name: Northwest Pipeline Evergreen Expansion
researcher_notes: Not an existing row under another name. The Northwest Gas Pipeline family has the system row P0230 and only cancelled or proposed expansion rows, none for Evergreen. The EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 299, lists NWPL Evergreen Expansion by Northwest Pipeline Co as completed on 9 October 2003: 26 miles of 36 inch pipe, 268 MMcf/d of added capacity, Federal Energy Regulatory Commission docket CP02-04. A Federal Register notice from October 2001 and the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission approved major projects list name the Evergreen Expansion Project in docket CP02-4. Press reports say 28 miles of loop (the order authorized 27.79 miles) in four segments in Skagit, King and Pierce Counties, Washington, with new compression. Length stated as 26 miles by EIA, which is about 42 km, above the 25 km threshold. Cost not staged: EIA says 240.9 million dollars and press said 198 million. Start and end points not found for the four loop segments. Owner spelling has no exact gazetteer match, so Northwest Pipeline LLC and Parent Williams Companies Inc need a check by ownership team. Federal Register and FERC pages were only verified to name the project; the length and diameter figures in them were not read from the pages, so they are not cited as refs for any value; the EIA row carries the values. Single validated source for values, so medium. Route: none researched; the completed loop is likely already inside the main line route, so check the routes repository before drawing.
